declared_readings: Key: ContentDigest, algorithm and digest, compared exactly with no case folding. The digest identifies the bytes; the manifest handle is caller-owned and may differ between clips of one file; asset_id is optional. Limit: identical bytes imported twice are one media item.

Studio-minted, not in the spec: schema id hsk.studio.media_markers@1, token media_markers, command ids media_marker.add, .replace, .remove, codes invalid_digest, invalid_marker, duplicate_marker, marker_missing, and every Rust and wire name beyond the clause, including AppearingMarker, ClipMarkers, SequenceMarkers, ClipMediaItem, clip_appearing_markers, sequence_appearing_markers.

Limits, Studio bounds: MAX_MEDIA_MARKER_ITEMS 4096, MAX_MEDIA_MARKERS 65536 (the per-sequence marker bound) over all items, MAX_MEDIA_MARKER_INPUT_BYTES 16 MiB whatever the budget allows; items and markers together charge Budget::nodes, their text Budget::payload_bytes. At the default budget that is 4096 nodes and 1 MiB.

An item with no marker has no entry. A stored entry with an empty marker list is refused InvalidField, so one state has one form; removing the last marker removes the item, and the last item removes the document entry.

One marker id space over three scopes. validate_document checks sequence and clip markers; the records check extends it to this scope. A commit or resync that gives a document marker an id a valid entry holds is refused folio_rejected, as the settings guard refuses. This is the entry's only hold on a document edit. An entry already invalid does not hold a commit up. An undo or redo landing on an id taken since is refused too.
One records step can move a marker between scopes, the id space being checked at the end of the step.
An item no clip is cut from is valid; no read lists such items.

Item 4, written and NOT RUN. Mapping: playback's, source_to_timeline for speed and reverse, the half-open window, rounding toward the clip start. A reversed point at source_in lands on the clip's exclusive end tick, matching clip_source_at.

Item 4, written and NOT RUN. Frame hold: a held clip plays one source tick, so a marker holding it spans the whole clip and any other is hidden, for the clip's own markers too. Exact tick match, no frame grid, so a marker inside the held frame past its first tick is hidden. A held frame outside the window still counts, as playback shows it. Vendor parity UNVERIFIED (D5).

Item 4, written and NOT RUN. A disabled clip still shows markers. A nested sequence or primitive source has no media item, ClipMediaItem says so, and inner clips' markers are not lifted to the outer clip. Hidden is a counter, summed per clip in a sequence read. More than MAX_MARKERS_PER_SEQUENCE appearing is limit_exceeded, never truncated. The walk is bounded by clips times markers and cancellable, with no separate scan budget.
